change.summary: Durably claim a queued local outbox operation as Indeterminate before crossing the target boundary, with exact immutable grant/lease/occurrence/topic/payload digest binding and strict no-replay semantics.
invariants: At most one dispatcher can append the fenced pre-dispatch claim for a queued occurrence.
A malformed, unbound, stale, or mismatched operation digest is rejected before any target call or lease mutation.
A target panic/crash after the boundary leaves the durable local outcome Indeterminate and cannot be redispatched from the old queued receipt.
A target-provided reason is preserved in the qualification dispatch receipt for status/reconcile; an unknown crash reason remains explicitly unresolved.
No SQLite schema migration, provider adapter, external effect, or production authority is introduced.
implementation: LocalLeaseOutbox::claim_dispatch verifies immutable operation binding, then appends the existing indeterminate event kind with dispatch_started_pending_ack payload inside the fenced write transaction.
ProductionOutboxDispatcher claims before target invocation; committed/rejected/indeterminate target outcomes are applied from the claimed state without a second dispatch marker.
The operation digest helper retains the existing hepta:production-outbox-operation:v1 framing and is shared by validation and request construction.
ProductionDispatchReceipt.target_reason is serde-defaulted for compatibility with older qualification receipts.

operation_digest.encoding: each field framed as u64 big-endian byte length followed by bytes, then SHA-256
operation_digest.validation: serialized digest syntax and recomputed digest must both match before claim

tests.name: crash_after_target_send_reopens_as_indeterminate_and_cannot_redispatch
assertions: retry of old queued receipt returns StaleReceipt

tests.name: concurrent_dispatchers_have_one_durable_claim_and_one_target_call
assertions: the other fails closed as StaleReceipt

tests.name: dispatch_claim_rejects_unbound_or_malformed_operation_digest
assertions: malformed digest returns Invalid without mutation
well-formed wrong digest returns StaleFence without mutation
correct recomputed digest claims exactly once

tests.result: pass; two existing EventRow/OutboxRow dead_code warnings only

tests.note: Existing candidate-baseline diagnostics; no diagnostic points at the added claim/digest/reason logic.
Repository candidate contains pre-existing formatter drift; added lines were manually formatted.

evidence.durable_claim: pre-target Indeterminate claim is append-only and fenced by current lease/generation/fencing token
evidence.crash_reopen: panic-after-send and reopen regression passed under local SQLite WAL/FULL qualification harness
evidence.concurrency: two simultaneous dispatchers produce one claim and one target invocation
evidence.digest_binding: malformed and wrong operation digests fail closed without journal mutation

known_gaps: A crash before a provider response cannot supply a provider-owned reason; external status lookup/reconcile remains required.
No provider physical exactly-once proof, signed provider ACK/status, external signer/trust-root, KMS/HSM, or production mutation authority is established.
No physical power-loss or media-failure durability run has been executed; WAL/FULL crash/reopen is local qualification only.
Strict clippy and repository formatter checks remain blocked by candidate-baseline diagnostics/drift and require a separate hygiene change.
